create_fixed_schedule: create a FixedSchedule LR scheduler with args and optimizer for a fixed learning rate schedule
add_fixed_schedule_args: add --force-anneal and --warmup-updates arguments to an argparse parser for the FixedSchedule scheduler
get_next_lr_fixed_schedule: get the next learning rate for a given epoch using the FixedSchedule scheduler
step_fixed_schedule: step the FixedSchedule scheduler at the end of an epoch to update the optimizer learning rate
step_update_fixed_schedule: step the FixedSchedule scheduler after each training update to handle warmup learning rate scaling
